connector.name: P4plan MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for P4 Plan - tasks, sprints, bugs, comments, custom fields via GraphQL API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package p4plan-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the perforce account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: P4PLAN_API_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: JWT bearer token for the P4 Plan GraphQL API. Forwarded as Authorization on every tool call.

env.name: P4PLAN_API_URL
env.description: URL of the P4 Plan GraphQL API (default: http://localhost:4000).

env.name: P4PLAN_ALLOW_SELF_SIGNED_CERTS
env.description: Set to 'true' to accept self-signed TLS certificates from the GraphQL API. Default: false.
